_about: One line per starting and race move for the /moves index: when it triggers, what it rolls, what you get. Written from the SRD text in class_moves.json; the full text is /moves move:. Keys are class|move, or class|race:Race.
bard|race:Elf: entering an important place → ask the GM for one fact from its history
bard|race:Human: entering a civilized settlement for the first time → someone takes you in as their guest
bard|Arcane Art: weave a performance into a spell (+Cha) → an ally heals 1d8, gets +1d4 damage, shakes off an enchantment, or +2 from aid
bard|Bardic Lore: first meeting an important creature, place or item in your lore → ask the GM one question, answered truthfully
bard|Charming and Open: speak frankly with someone → ask them a question they must answer truthfully (they may ask one back)
bard|A Port in the Storm: back in a settlement you've visited → say when you were last there; the GM says how it's changed
cleric|race:Dwarf: when you commune → also gain Words of the Unspeaking for stone, as a rote
cleric|race:Human: one wizard spell of your choice can be granted and cast as a cleric spell
cleric|Deity: your god grants your spells; their domain and your religion's precept shape what you can petition for
cleric|Divine Guidance: petition your god by your religion's precept → gain useful knowledge or a boon from their domain
cleric|Turn Undead: brandish your holy symbol and pray (+Wis) → undead can't come within reach; on 10+ they're dazed or flee
cleric|Commune: an hour in communion with your god → swap your granted spells (total levels up to your level+1) and get your rotes
cleric|Cast a Spell: cast a granted spell (+Wis) → it works; on 7–9 you draw attention, take -1 ongoing to cast, or lose the spell
druid|race:Elf: the Great Forest always counts as your land, as well as any other
druid|race:Human: you can always shapeshift into any domesticated animal
druid|race:Halfling: when you make camp → you and your allies heal +1d6
druid|Born of the Soil: you're attuned to a land; you can shapeshift into any animal that might live there
druid|By Nature Sustained: you never need to eat or drink; ignore any ration you'd mark off
druid|Spirit Tongue: you understand animals native to your land, or whose essence you've studied
druid|Shapeshifter: call on the spirits to change shape (+Wis) → become an animal from your land; hold 3 (10+), 2 (7–9), 1 (miss) to use its moves
druid|Studied Essence: spend time contemplating an animal's spirit → you can shapeshift into that species from now on
fighter|race:Dwarf: share a drink with someone → parley with them using Con instead of Cha
fighter|race:Elf: one weapon type of your choice always counts as precise for you
fighter|race:Halfling: defy danger by using your small size → take +1
fighter|race:Human: once per battle → reroll any one damage roll, yours or someone else's
fighter|Bend Bars, Lift Gates: smash an obstacle with pure strength (+Str) → it breaks; choose 3 (10+) or 2 (7–9): quick, quiet, nothing valuable broken, fixable
fighter|Armored: you ignore the clumsy tag on armour you wear
fighter|Signature Weapon: your own weapon, with the range and two enhancements you chose for it
paladin|race:Human: pray and ask "What here is evil?" → the GM tells you honestly
paladin|Lay on Hands (Cha): touch someone and pray (+Cha) → heal 1d8 or cure a disease; on 7–9 it passes to you instead
paladin|Armored: you ignore the clumsy tag on armour you wear
paladin|I Am the Law: order an NPC on divine authority (+Cha) → they obey, flee or attack you (their pick); 10+ also +1 forward against them
paladin|Quest: swear a quest in prayer → gain up to two boons (direction, invulnerability, true senses…) while you keep the GM's vows
ranger|race:Elf: on a perilous journey through wilderness → your job succeeds as if you rolled 10+
ranger|race:Human: making camp in a dungeon or city → you don't use a ration
ranger|Hunt and Track (Wis): follow a creature's trail (+Wis) → you track it until it changes course; on 10+ also learn something about it
ranger|Called Shot: shoot a surprised or defenceless enemy (+Dex) → hit the head (dazed), arms (drops what it holds) or legs (hobbled); 10+ adds damage
ranger|Animal Companion: a loyal animal that always does as you wish, with its own ferocity, cunning, armour and training
ranger|Command: work with your companion at something it's trained in → add its stats to your damage, rolls or armour
thief|race:Halfling: attacking with a ranged weapon → deal +2 damage
thief|race:Human: spout lore or discern realities about crime → take +1
thief|Trap Expert: survey a dangerous area (+Dex) → hold 3 (10+) or 1 (7–9): ask about traps, what they do, and what's hidden
thief|Tricks of the Trade: pick locks or pockets, or disable traps (+Dex) → you do it; on 7–9 the GM offers suspicion, danger or cost
thief|Backstab: attack a surprised or defenceless enemy in melee (+Dex) → choose 2 (10+) or 1 (7–9): +1d6 damage, -1 armour, +1 forward, stay out of melee
thief|Flexible Morals: anyone detecting your alignment → you tell them any alignment you like
thief|Poisoner: one poison is safe in your hands; start with three uses and brew three more with time and a safe place
wizard|race:Elf: Detect Magic is a cantrip for you
wizard|race:Human: one cleric spell of your choice can be cast as a wizard spell
wizard|Spellbook: holds your spells: three 1st-level spells and the cantrips to start, plus one new spell each level
wizard|Prepare Spells: an hour with your spellbook → prepare spells (total levels up to your level+1), plus all your cantrips
wizard|Cast a Spell (Int): cast a prepared spell (+Int) → it works; on 7–9 you draw attention, take -1 ongoing to cast, or forget it
wizard|Spell Defense: end an ongoing spell to deflect an attack → subtract the spell's level from the damage
wizard|Ritual: draw on a place of power → create any magical effect, on the GM's conditions (time, cost, help, danger…)
barbarian|race:Dwarf: each session the GM asks about your homeland → answer to mark XP
barbarian|race:Elf: each session the GM asks about your homeland → answer to mark XP
barbarian|race:Halfling: each session the GM asks about your homeland → answer to mark XP
barbarian|race:Human: each session the GM asks about your homeland → answer to mark XP
barbarian|Full Plate and Packing Steel: you ignore the clumsy tag on armour you wear
barbarian|Unencumbered, Unharmed: under your Load with no armour or shield → +1 armour
barbarian|Herculean Appetites: chasing one of your appetites → roll 1d6+1d8 instead of 2d6; if the d6 is higher, a complication follows
barbarian|The Upper Hand: +1 to Last Breath; on a 7–9 you can bargain with Death for your life
barbarian|Musclebound: any weapon you wield is forceful and messy
barbarian|What Are You Waiting For?: shout a challenge (+Con) → on 10+ they all come at you and you deal +2 damage to them; on 7–9 only the weakest do
